content: Start the hike now; the trail gets crowded by mid-morning.
I was planning to go around noon.
Change your plan—go now to enjoy cooler air and peace on the trail.
Do you think I’ll need a jacket this early?
Yes—pack a light jacket to stay warm.
Okay, I’ll pack that and some snacks.
Bring water—there’s no refill station until halfway.
Alright, I’m ready to head out now.
